title: Acoustic Exposure Dynamics Dataset
description: An anonymized companion dataset for privacy-oriented dB-only operational acoustic monitoring in occupied offices. It contains aggregate features, mixed-effects outputs, cross-deployment comparisons, uncontrolled device-versus-reference co-locations, secondary archived-data analyses, metadata, and figures. It excludes raw audio, raw deployment logs, row-level timestamps, hardware identifiers, customer names, team labels, original floor labels, and labeled floor-plan images.
